header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: recites it, his former and latter sins are forgiven. And whoever, after putting on a garment, recites the Du'a ()اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّي وَلَاقُوَّةٍ “All praise is for Allah Ta'ala alone! He clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any effort or strength of mine”, his former and latter sins are forgiven, Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) has narrated that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of latter sins being forgiven is that in the future Allah Ta'ala will protect His servant from sins.
(Badhl al-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْباً جَدِيدًا فَقَالَ: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَورَتِي وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِي ثُمَّ عَمَدَ إِلَي الثَّوْبِ الَّذِي أَخْلَقَ فَتَصَدَّقَ بِهِ كَانَ فِي كَنَفِ اللهِ وَفِي حِفْظِ اللهِ وَفِي سِتْرِ اللهِ حَيّاًوَّ مَيِّتاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث غريب احاديث شتي من ابواب الدعوات رقم:٣٥٦٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person, after putting on a new garment, recites the Du'a (اَلْحَمْدُ )لِلّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي مَا أُوَارِي بِهِ عَورَتِي وَأَتَجَمَّلُ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِيAll praise is for Allah Ta'ala alone! He clothed me; with that garment I cover the parts of my body that must be covered. And through it I attain adornment in my life', and then gives his old garment in sadaqah, he will be in the protection and shelter of Allah Ta'ala during his lifetime and after his death. And Allah Ta'ala conceals his sins behind a veil”, Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab (RA) has narrated that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.
